case.name: Concurso 36/2012
case.court: Juzgado de lo Mercantil nº 1 de Las Palmas
case.scope_warning: LPB's insolvency estate is not the whole mixed-ownership Sun Park complex. Do not infer title, possession or authority over Matkator or third-party property from an LPB insolvency act without asset-specific proof.

reading_rules: recognised insolvency credit != mortgage liability != competitive threshold != debt stated as consideration for the dacion != Registry value != possible surplus
definitive approval on 18 May 2021 != two 15 October decisions != two clarification Autos on 26 January 2022 != deed execution on 21 February 2022

Protocol 457 reportedly recites 26 January on page 10 and 22 January on page 11; that internal notarial inconsistency is a reconciliation target, not a judicial-order candidate, and the signed 26 January judicial originals control their own date and function
later deed or Registry implementation does not automatically cure an earlier authority, competition, credit-classification or non-convalidation issue
documentary difference alone does not prove nullity, fraud, bad faith, surplus or criminal responsibility

records.label: Signed order controlling the separate 2018 premises/pools disposal
records.safe_proposition: The controlled source bundle verifies the 2019 non-convalidation outcome, leaving the separate premises/pools and EUR 400,000 line as an autonomous implementation/accounting question.
open_bridge: bank and ledger treatment of EUR 400,000

records.label: Signed better-bid / interest reconstruction order
records.safe_proposition: The order explains the arithmetic route toward the mortgage-liability cap through subsequent accrual; it does not by itself establish final insolvency-credit classification.

records.label: Competitive notice / edict
records.safe_proposition: The notice separates mortgage components, the premises/pools amount and Community-fee component for the competitive threshold.
open_bridge: later legal function of each amount

records.label: Third-party acquisition proposal
records.safe_proposition: A concrete EUR 14.8m proposal existed. Auto 164/2021 later records the third party's nonappearance and failure to lodge the bond; it states that, after those events, the competitive licitation could not take place and definitively approves CAM.

records.label: Auto 164/2021 · definitive CAM approval
records.safe_proposition: The Auto records a EUR 14.8m third-party proposal, nonappearance and failure to lodge the bond; it states that, after those events, the competitive licitation could not take place and definitively approves CAM's enumerated proposal. This is kept distinct from the later clarification that a licitation appearance occurred and was not an auction.

records.label: First described 15 October act
records.safe_proposition: One of two separate 15-October decisions resolves a challenge in the approval/licitation sequence. It must remain separate from the same-date companion act and the later clarification.

records.label: Second described 15 October act
records.safe_proposition: The companion 15-October decision separately resolves the licitation-procedure branch. It did not create a new third-party asset transfer and was later the subject of clarification.

records.label: First clarification Auto concerning a 15 October decision
records.safe_proposition: This Auto clarifies a 15 October act. It does not newly adjudicate assets, calculate a surplus or replace the definitive CAM approval of 18 May 2021.
open_bridge: complete clarification application and opposition pack

records.label: Second clarification Auto concerning the companion 15 October decision
records.safe_proposition: This Auto clarifies that the procedural mechanism was a licitation appearance, not an auction. It does not newly adjudicate assets, calculate a surplus or replace the definitive CAM approval of 18 May 2021.
open_bridge: complete clarification application and opposition pack

records.label: Protocol 457 internal 26/22 January date inconsistency
records.safe_proposition: Protocol 457 reportedly refers to 26 January on page 10 and 22 January on page 11. This inconsistency belongs to the deed's recital layer; it is not evidence of a separate 22 January judicial order and cannot replace the two signed 26 January clarification Autos.
open_bridge: certified deed pagination and exact recitals
notarial source or correction for 22 January

records.label: Public deed no. 457
records.safe_proposition: The deed transfers the described mortgaged properties to CAM, states EUR 13,168,082.02 as debt serving as consideration for the dacion, requires communication to the Mercantile Court within five calendar days and contains cancellation requests.
open_bridge: legal-function bridge for the stated debt
reconciliation of the page 10/page 11 recital-date inconsistency

records.label: Post-deed communication to Mercantile Court
records.safe_proposition: Deed 457 creates a specific downstream communication trace that should be independently verified.

records.label: Registry implementation and cancellations
records.safe_proposition: Later Registry implementation does not by itself establish the correctness of every upstream credit, authority, competitive or accounting proposition.

records.label: Liquidation accounts / residual closure
records.safe_proposition: No surplus or absence of surplus should be presumed from deed 457 alone.
